responsibility: This is the main SPARC backend implementation file. It owns target hooks, option override logic, cost tables, ABI and register handling, prologue/epilogue and call generation, operand legitimization, PIC/TLS addressing, compare/branch and move expansion, atomic and synchronization support, builtin and floating-environment helpers, scheduling- and errata-related utilities, and many assembler output routines, consuming the machine-description predicates/attributes and producing SPARC-specific RTL expansions, hook decisions, and assembly text.
same_name_distinction: This is the C++ implementation file for the SPARC backend’s procedural logic and target hook code, whereas sparc.h provides compile-time macros/interfaces, sparc.md encodes RTL instruction patterns and attributes, and sparc.opt declares command-line options and generated option variables.
